fields.body_md:
## At a glance

The University of Southampton offers one-year master's courses in computing, data science and business. This page covers MSc Computer Science, MSc Data Science and the MBA. All three start in September 2027.

The first thing to know is cost. For MSc Computer Science, tuition for international students is **£36,800** for the year. You do not pay an application fee for 2027 starts.

| | MSc Computer Science | MSc Data Science | MBA |
|---|---|---|---|
| Tuition for international students, per year | **£36,800** | **£36,800** | **£37,400** |
| Length | 1 year, full-time | 1 year, full-time | 1 year, full-time |
| Next start | September 2027 | September 2027 | September 2027 |
| Degree needed | 2:1 | 2:1 | 2:2, plus 3 years' work experience |
| English test (IELTS) | Overall 6.5, 6.0 in each skill | Overall 6.5, 6.0 in each skill | Overall 6.5, 6.0 in each skill |
| Campus | Highfield | Highfield | Boldrewood |

## What it really costs

Tuition is the fee for the course, charged for each year of study.

You also pay a deposit. International full-time students pay **£2,000** of their tuition in advance. A deposit is a payment made early. This one is part of your tuition, not an extra fee. Ask the university when it is due.

### Money for the UK student visa

Your visa costs are separate from tuition. For a student studying outside London, these are the figures:

- **Visa fee:** £558 to apply for a Student visa from outside the UK.
- **Health surcharge:** £776 for each year of your visa. The Immigration Health Surcharge is paid as part of the visa application.
- **Living money:** £1,171 for each month of your course, for up to 9 months. Check this figure on the gov.uk page before you apply.

The living money is money you show for the visa. It is not a fee. You must have had enough money for 28 days in a row. The last day of that 28-day period must be within 31 days of the day you apply.

You also need a CAS, which is a Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies. The university issues it to you, and your visa application needs it.

### Worked first-year cost: MSc Computer Science

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Tuition, 1 year | £36,800 |
| Living money: £1,171 × 9 months | £10,539 |
| Student visa fee | £558 |
| Health surcharge | £776 or more |
| **Total** | **at least £48,673** |

The total is £36,800 + £10,539 + £558 + £776 = £48,673, so the total is at least £48,673. Your visa lasts longer than your course, so you usually pay for more than one year. A 16-month visa costs £1,164.

This is an example, not a budget.

To see how the visa works step by step, read our [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide). To compare the cost of UK study more widely, read the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

## Ways to reduce the cost

### MSc Computer Science: Global Talent Award

The Dean of the Faculty of Engineering and Physical Sciences Global Talent Award takes **£10,000** off your fees. Up to **5** awards are given. Apply by **30 April 2027, 5pm UK time**.

To qualify, you must:

- have permanent residence in an eligible country. Check the scholarship page for the list of eligible countries.
- pay the overseas fee yourself.
- have a conditional or unconditional offer.
- exceed the entry requirements.

The award does not cover postgraduate diplomas or certificates, distance learning, or study abroad. It is listed for MSc Computer Science. Check the scholarship page before you assume it covers another course.

### MBA: Global Talent Award

The Dean of Southampton Business School Global MBA Award takes up to **£25,000** off your fees. Awards range from **£17,000** to **£25,000**. There are up to **11** awards in three rounds.

| Round | Awards | Apply by |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 3 awards of £25,000 | 28 November 2026, 5pm UK time |
| 2 | 5 awards of £20,000 | 1 March 2027, 5pm UK time |
| 3 | 3 awards of £17,000 | 29 May 2027, 5pm UK time |

You must be self-funded, have permanent residence in an eligible country (check the scholarship page for the list of eligible countries), and attend an interview.

## Getting in

A **2:1** is the UK grade for an upper second-class honours degree. A **2:2** is the lower second-class grade.

- **MSc Computer Science:** a 2:1 degree.
- **MSc Data Science:** a 2:1 degree in computer science or a closely related subject. The course page also sets limits by the kind of institution you studied at, so read it for your university.
- **MBA:** a 2:2 degree and 3 years' professional experience. You also need an interview. The course asks for experience supervising or managing people.

The English test is **IELTS**, a test of English language skills. You need an overall score of **6.5**, with **6.0** in each of reading, writing, speaking and listening. This is the same for all three courses.

Southampton sets grade requirements for Indian degrees in tiers. The university's India entry page shows which tier applies. Read it before you apply.

## Deadlines

| Course | Intake | Apply by (international applicants) |
|---|---|---|
| MSc Computer Science | September 2027 | Wednesday 18 August 2027, midday UK time |
| MSc Data Science | September 2027 | Wednesday 18 August 2027, midday UK time |
| MBA | September 2027 | Wednesday 4 August 2027, midday UK time |

Apply early. You can apply for the student visa up to 6 months before your course starts. From outside the UK, gov.uk says a decision usually takes 3 weeks.

## Related courses at Southampton

Southampton also runs other master's courses in the same subject area. These include [MSc Artificial Intelligence](https://www.southampton.ac.uk/courses/artificial-intelligence-masters-msc), [MSc Cyber Security](https://www.southampton.ac.uk/courses/cyber-security-masters-msc), [MSc Machine Learning](https://www.southampton.ac.uk/courses/machine-learning-masters-msc), [MSc Software Engineering](https://www.southampton.ac.uk/courses/software-engineering-masters-msc) and [MSc Internet of Things](https://www.southampton.ac.uk/courses/internet-of-things-masters-msc). Check each course page for its own fee and entry rules.

## Where you'll live

MSc Computer Science and MSc Data Science are based at Highfield. The MBA is listed at Boldrewood.

The university's accommodation fees for 2026-27 run from **£139.09** a week to **£284.48** a week. The lowest price is a basic room with a shared bathroom, paid over 41 weeks. The highest is a one-bedroom flat for couples, paid over 51 weeks. These are 2026-27 rates. Check the accommodation fees page for the year you start.

## Who it's a good fit for

**A strong choice if:**

- You have a 2:1 degree and want a one-year master's in computing or data science.
- You can show living money of £1,171 a month for up to 9 months, outside London.
- You meet the rules for the Global Talent Award and want to apply for it.

**Think carefully if:**

- Your degree is lower than a 2:1 and you want an MSc Computer Science or MSc Data Science.
- You want the MBA but have less than 3 years of professional experience.
- Your IELTS is below 6.5 overall, or below 6.0 in any skill.
- You need a scholarship to pay the fee, and you are not sure you will get one.

## Sources

Checked on 3 November 2026 for the Southampton pages, and on 1 November 2026 for the gov.uk pages.

- [MSc Computer Science](https://www.southampton.ac.uk/courses/computer-science-masters-msc)
- [MSc Data Science](https://www.southampton.ac.uk/courses/data-science-masters-msc)
- [MBA](https://www.southampton.ac.uk/courses/master-of-business-administration-masters-mba)
- [Global Talent Award, Faculty of Engineering and Physical Sciences](https://www.southampton.ac.uk/study/fees-funding/scholarships/engineering-physical-science-global)
- [Global MBA Award, Southampton Business School](https://www.southampton.ac.uk/study/fees-funding/scholarships/southampton-business-school-deans-global-mba)
- [Accommodation fees](https://www.southampton.ac.uk/student-life/accommodation/fees-contracts)
- [Entry qualifications for India](https://www.southampton.ac.uk/international/entry-qualification-equivalencies/india)
- [Student visa (gov.uk)](https://www.gov.uk/student-visa)
- [Financial evidence for the student visa (gov.uk)](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/financial-evidence-for-student-and-child-student-route-applicants)
- [Healthcare surcharge](https://www.gov.uk/healthcare-immigration-application/how-much-pay)

Fees and rules change. Always confirm on the university's own website before you pay or apply.

faq_json.q: How much is tuition for MSc Computer Science at Southampton for Indian students?
faq_json.a: The international fee for MSc Computer Science is £36,800 a year for a one-year, full-time course starting in September 2027. The first-year cost including living money and visa fees is at least £48,673.

faq_json.q: What IELTS score does Southampton ask for?
faq_json.a: You need an overall IELTS score of 6.5, with 6.0 in each of reading, writing, speaking and listening. This is the same for MSc Computer Science, MSc Data Science and the MBA.

faq_json.q: When is the Southampton application deadline for September 2027?
faq_json.a: For MSc Computer Science and MSc Data Science, the deadline for international applicants is Wednesday 18 August 2027, midday UK time. For the MBA it is Wednesday 4 August 2027, midday UK time.

faq_json.q: Does Southampton charge an application fee?
faq_json.a: No. There is no application fee for postgraduate courses starting in 2027. The £2,000 tuition deposit is a separate payment, and it is part of your tuition.

faq_json.q: Is there a scholarship at Southampton for Indian students?
faq_json.a: Yes, for some courses. The Global Talent Award for MSc Computer Science takes £10,000 off your fees. Up to 5 awards are given, and applications close on 30 April 2027, 5pm UK time. Check the scholarship page for the list of eligible countries. You must have permanent residence in an eligible country.

faq_json.q: How much money do I need to show for the UK student visa for Southampton?
faq_json.a: If you study outside London, you must show £1,171 for each month of your course, for up to 9 months. For 9 months that is £10,539. You must have had this money for 28 days in a row.
